quests.instruction: Which word describes the two grown-ups whose last name you often share?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This word names your mother and father together.
quests.explanation: Parents describes the two grown-ups whose last name you often share.
quests.funFact: In some families, children take a last name from just one parent, and in others, from both!

quests.instruction: Which word do you use to talk about your grandmother and grandfather as a pair?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: It is the plural word for two specific family members.
quests.explanation: Grandparents is the word used to talk about your grandmother and grandfather as a pair.
quests.funFact: Visiting grandparents is often a favorite part of school holidays for many children!

quests.instruction: Which family member do many children call 'Grandma' or 'Nana'?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is older than your mother or father.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is often called 'Grandma' or 'Nana' by children.
quests.funFact: A grandmother often has wonderful old stories to tell about when your parent was young!

quests.instruction: Which word do you use to describe your parents, siblings, and grandparents as one whole group?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word is the biggest term, covering every relative at once.
quests.explanation: Family is the word used to describe your parents, siblings, and grandparents as one whole group.
quests.funFact: No matter how big or small, every family has its own special way of showing love!

quests.instruction: Which family member has been part of the family for the longest time, along with grandmother?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He belongs to the oldest generation in your close family.
quests.explanation: Grandfather has been part of the family for a very long time, often along with grandmother.
quests.funFact: Grandfathers often love telling the same favorite family story again and again!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the man half of your two parents, along with your mother?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: Think about who is married to your mother.
quests.explanation: Father is the man half of your two parents, along with your mother.
quests.funFact: Together, a father and mother make up the pair called 'parents'!

quests.instruction: Which family member is often the smallest person shown in a family photo?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This is the youngest member of the whole family.
quests.explanation: Baby is often the smallest person in a family photo since they are the youngest.
quests.funFact: Family photos with a new baby are often kept as treasured memories for years to come!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the daughter in the family who is not you?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: Think of a girl close to your own age at home.
quests.explanation: Sister is the daughter in the family other than you.
quests.funFact: Not every family has a sister — some have only brothers, and some have both!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the woman half of your two parents, along with your father?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: Think about who is married to your father.
quests.explanation: Mother is the woman half of your two parents, along with your father.
quests.funFact: Together, a mother and father make up the pair called 'parents'!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the son in the family who is not you?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: Think of a boy close to your own age at home.
quests.explanation: Brother is the son in the family other than you.
quests.funFact: Not every family has a brother — some have only sisters, and some have both!

quests.instruction: Which word means the two grown-ups who are directly responsible for raising you?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This word names your mother and father as a pair.
quests.explanation: Parents means the two grown-ups who are directly responsible for raising you.
quests.funFact: Around the world, families can look very different, but the job of parents is always to love and guide their children!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the two people who are the parents of your mom or your dad?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This word names a matching pair, one man and one woman.
quests.explanation: Grandparents describes the two people who are the parents of your mom or your dad.
quests.funFact: In many cultures, grandparents live together with their children and grandchildren in one home!

quests.instruction: In a family tree, which family member is drawn two levels above you, as a woman?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: She is your mother's or father's mother.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is drawn two levels above you on a family tree, as a woman.
quests.funFact: Some family trees go back many generations, showing great-grandparents too!

quests.instruction: Which word describes all the people who are related to you, like your parents and siblings?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word covers your whole group of relatives, not just two people.
quests.explanation: Family is the word for all the people who are related to you, like your parents and siblings.
quests.funFact: The word 'family' can also describe a group of close friends who feel like relatives!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the father of your mother or your father?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: This family member belongs to the oldest generation you know well.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is the father of your mother or your father.
quests.funFact: Grandfathers are called different loving names in different families, like Grandpa, Pop, or Poppy!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your grandfather's own son, from your dad's side of the family?
quests.question: Father
quests.hint: He is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Father is your grandfather's own son, if you look at your dad's side of the family.
quests.funFact: Every father was once a son himself, just like every child grows up one day!

quests.instruction: Which family member would need a grown-up's help to hold their own bottle?
quests.question: Baby
quests.hint: This family member is far too young to do things alone yet.
quests.explanation: Baby would need a grown-up's help since they are too young to hold things well alone.
quests.funFact: Babies slowly learn to hold their own bottle as their tiny hand muscles grow stronger!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl who shares both your mother and your father?
quests.question: Sister
quests.hint: She is your own age group, not a parent or grandparent.
quests.explanation: Sister is a girl who shares both your mother and your father.
quests.funFact: A sister and her sibling often grow up learning many of the same family traditions!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your grandmother's own daughter, from your mom's side of the family?
quests.question: Mother
quests.hint: She is one of your two parents.
quests.explanation: Mother is your grandmother's own daughter, if you look at your mom's side of the family.
quests.funFact: Every mother was once a daughter herself, just like every child grows up one day!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy who shares both your mother and your father?
quests.question: Brother
quests.hint: He is your own age group, not a parent or grandparent.
quests.explanation: Brother is a boy who shares both your mother and your father.
quests.funFact: A brother and his sibling often grow up learning many of the same family traditions!

quests.instruction: Which family member group takes care of you every day as you grow up?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This group is one generation above you, directly.
quests.explanation: Parents are the family member group that takes care of you every day as you grow up.
quests.funFact: Parents are usually the first teachers a child ever has, even before school begins!

quests.instruction: Which word means your grandmother plus your grandfather, added together?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This is a plural word naming two people, not one.
quests.explanation: Grandparents means your grandmother plus your grandfather together.
quests.funFact: Some lucky children get to have all four of their grandparents together at big celebrations!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the woman one generation above your mother or father?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: Think about who your mom or dad calls their own mother.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is one generation above your mother or father on the family tree.
quests.funFact: On a family tree, grandmothers are usually drawn two levels above their grandchildren!

quests.instruction: Which word describes your whole group of relatives, big or small?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word can describe just a few people or a very large group.
quests.explanation: Family describes your whole group of relatives, whether the group is big or small.
quests.funFact: Some families are small with just a few members, while others are huge with dozens of relatives!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your parent's own father?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is the man your mom or dad calls 'Dad'.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is your parent's own father.
quests.funFact: Your mom or dad was once a child, just like you, being raised by their own father!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the two people who are your mother and your father?
quests.question: Parents
quests.hint: This word names a matching pair, one man and one woman, directly above you.
quests.explanation: Parents describes the two people who are your mother and your father.
quests.funFact: Some children live with both parents, and others live with just one — every family is unique!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the older generation that raised your own mother or father?
quests.question: Grandparents
quests.hint: This word includes both a grandmother and a grandfather together.
quests.explanation: Grandparents describes the older generation who raised your own mother or father.
quests.funFact: Grandparents often remember games and songs from long ago that they can teach to you!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the mother of either your mom or your dad?
quests.question: Grandmother
quests.hint: Think of the woman who raised your mother or your father.
quests.explanation: Grandmother is the mother of either your mom or your dad.
quests.funFact: A grandmother might live nearby, or she might live far away and visit sometimes!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the group you belong to made up of parents, siblings, and other relatives?
quests.question: Family
quests.hint: This word is broader than just naming two or three people.
quests.explanation: Family describes the whole group you belong to, made up of parents, siblings, and other relatives.
quests.funFact: Being part of a family means always having people to celebrate good news with!

quests.instruction: Which family member is older than your parents and is a man?
quests.question: Grandfather
quests.hint: He is the parent of one of your parents.
quests.explanation: Grandfather is a man who is older than your parents, since he is their parent.
quests.funFact: Grandfathers sometimes teach their grandchildren how to fish or fix things!
